description: Erection of a single-storey rear infil brick extension, replace non-original timber sash windows with timber sash windows, alteration to window opening at lower ground floor level to modern rear extension to take new aluminium framed glazed door. Replace artificial slate to front pitch with natural slate; replace existing velux rooflights to front and rear pitched roofs with conservation rooflights; reinstate decorative gable to front elevation to match original with integrated swift brick; reinstate copings to front gable; replace upvc drainage goods with cast iron. Remove non-original cast iron pot guards to front and rear. Helical bar repair to brickwork; lime repointing. To front garden relay drainage with new manholes; lift and relay york stone paving; new timber bin store; repair stone front steps. Replace modern railings and gate with cast iron railings and gate on new stone coping. Raise brick piers and replace caps with cast stone to match original. Repair railings to side boundaries. To rear garden: new bike store; new ASHP, new stone paving to side passage. To lower ground floor interior: replace concrete floor slabs with limecrete; structural opening in flank wall to modern extension; alterations to modern partitions; replace internal modern glazed doors with traditional panelled doors; new panelled bifold doors to spine wall; wall linings as shown. Open up fireplace to rear room with new chimney piece, hearth and linings. New bottom step to staircase; fitted joinery. At upper ground floor interior: insulated linings and new fitted joinery to modern extension; restore plaster mouldings; rehang existing doors to hand. At first and second floors replace interior modern doors with traditional panelled doors; new bathrooms with associated drainage; internal insulated wall linings; new cornice to front room. At first floor open up fireplaces with new chimney pieces, hearth and linings. At second floor new access hatch and ladder to loft.
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The Development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 18(a) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 as amended.

<p>Details of all proposed structural alterations and interventions including helical bar repairs shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA prior to the commencement of the relevant part of the works. The submitted details shall include detailed drawings and specifications prepared by a structural surveyor or engineer. The work shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the details so approved and shall be maintained as such thereafter.&nbsp; REASON: In order to protect the special interest of the listed building.&nbsp;</p>

<p>A sample panel of brickwork proposed for use in the restoration of the decorative gable shall be made available for inspection on site and shall be approved in writing by the LPA prior to the commencement of the relevant part of the work. The sample panel shall accurately reflect the proposed brick, brick bond, pointing style, mortar mix and soot washing, and shall be retained on site until the work is complete. The work shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the details so approved and shall be maintained as such thereafter.&nbsp; REASON: In order to protect the special interest of the listed building.&nbsp;</p>

<p>Details of proposed exterior repointing work shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA prior to the commencement of the relevant part of the work. The details shall include: Details of the location and extent of repointing&nbsp; A concise methodology for the work and details of proposed mortar materials and mix A trial panel of less than 1 square metre in area, prepared on site and made available for inspection The work shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the details so approved and shall be maintained as such thereafter.&nbsp; REASON: In order to protect the special interest of the listed building.&nbsp;</p>

<p>Full details of proposed damp remedial work at lower ground floor including recommendations from an appropriately qualified surveyor or damp specialist shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA prior to the commencement of the relevant part of the work.&nbsp; The work shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the details so approved and shall be maintained as such thereafter.&nbsp; REASON: In order to protect the special interest of the listed building.&nbsp;</p>

<p>The following shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA prior to the commencement of the relevant part of the works: Details of proposed internal and external lighting including the type and location of all proposed light fittings Details of proposed works to internal plaster cornices including a concise methodology for proposed repairs/restoration, and the location and design of proposed new cornicing Details of proposed roof insulation at rafter level including the proposed materials, specifications and detailing of the insulation and a concise methodology for its installation details of all external materials and fixtures for use in the extension and roof work, including materials, colours, finishes, product details, product images (where applicable) and sample images (where applicable) Details of all external vents and flues including elevations showing the locations of the fixtures and the size, product details, material, colour and finish for each fixture Details of proposed plumbing routes Details of proposed wall insulation including its exact location and extent, proposed materials, specifications and detailing Details of proposed replacement windows including a full set of drawings (elevations at 1:20 and sections and details at 1:5) showing each window and its masonry surround, with proposed material, colour, finish, glazing specification and putty/glazing bar detail clearly shown&nbsp; Details of proposed external heat pump and any acoustic housing Details of all proposed internal joinery and doors including scale drawings as appropriate Details of proposed works to railings and external steps including large scale drawings and details of materials, methods and finishes Details of new chimney pieces and hearths Details of proposed rooflights with external shutters A methodology for proposed repairs to front lightwell and retaining wall Details of proposed bin enclosures including scale drawings, materials and finishes Details of proposed limecrete slab including the depth of proposed excavation and details of the proposed floor build-up and finished floor levels The work shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the details so approved and shall be maintained as such thereafter.&nbsp; REASON: In order to protect the special interest of the listed building.&nbsp;</p>
